# factfile.md

> factfile.md is an open standard for one Markdown file at the root of a website that gives AI agents a business's key facts (what it offers, who it is for and not for, what it costs and how to start), each linked to the page that shows it.

The specification is version 0.1, a draft for public comment, created by Alan Kiayi and published under CC BY 4.0. Free MIT-licensed tools draft a file from a website, check it, make the human-readable Key facts page and write a setup guide; they run in the browser at https://factfile.dev/generate or with `npx factfile`. Every page on this site is also available as Markdown (add `.md` to the address, or send `Accept: text/markdown`).

## Key facts

- [factfile.md](https://factfile.dev/factfile.md): key facts about this project: what it offers, who it is for, prices and how to start

## Pages

- [factfile.md: checkable business facts for AI agents](https://factfile.dev/index.md): factfile.md is an open standard for one Markdown file at a website's root that gives AI agents a business's key facts, each linked to the page that shows it.
- [What is factfile.md? The business facts file for AI agents](https://factfile.dev/what-is-factfile.md): factfile.md is a Markdown file at a website's root that gives AI agents a business's key facts, each linked to its source. How it compares with llms.txt.
- [Generate a factfile.md from your website, free](https://factfile.dev/generate.md): Draft a factfile.md from your website in your browser, fill in what only you can answer, check it with the official validator and download every file you need.
- [factfile.md specification v0.1 (draft)](https://factfile.dev/spec.md): The factfile.md specification: file format, sections, profiles, integrity rules, conformance levels and the agent reading protocol.
- [factfile tools: generate, check and publish factfile.md](https://factfile.dev/tools.md): Free, open-source command-line tools to draft a factfile.md from your website, check it, make the human page and set up the signposts.
- [About factfile.md and its author](https://factfile.dev/about.md): factfile.md was created by Alan Kiayi, a product builder in the UK, to give AI agents facts they can check.
- [Support factfile.md: buy me a coffee](https://factfile.dev/support.md): factfile.md and its tools are free and open source. If they help you, you can support the work with a coffee.

## Optional

- [Full text for language models](https://factfile.dev/llms-full.txt): the specification, the explainer, the questions and this site's factfile.md in one file
- [Source code](https://github.com/factfile-dev/factfile): specification, examples and tools on GitHub
- [Examples](https://github.com/factfile-dev/factfile/tree/main/examples): complete files for a software product, a local business and an online shop
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/factfile): the command-line tools
- [Agent skill](https://factfile.dev/.well-known/agent-skills/factfile/SKILL.md): how an agent reads, writes and checks factfile.md files
